name: ceramics-api
description: The Ceramics store backend: product catalog (CRUD, search/filter, stock tracking with auto sold-out), cart management, checkout with card payment via Stripe, order persistence and history, and order confirmation email. Serves both the Shopper storefront and the Store Admin console behind role-based authorization. Renders no UI itself.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Validates the bearer token the gateway forwards on every call and resolves the caller's role (shopper vs store-admin).

dependencies.name: ceramics-db
dependencies.description: Stores products (with stock quantity), carts and cart items, and orders with their line items.

dependencies.name: stripe
dependencies.description: Stripe's public REST API (Payment Intents resource), used to charge the shopper's card at checkout.

config.description: Stripe secret API key used to create and confirm payment intents.

dependencies.name: email-provider
dependencies.description: SendGrid, used to send the order confirmation email to the shopper once payment succeeds.

config.description: SendGrid API key used to send transactional email.
